english: I see it in its eyes. One day... we will be food as well, the BLACK RAT intones.
Obviously! the RED RAT puffs out his chest. "The future depends on us and our ability to-"
Please don't get him started again, the WHITE RAT pleads.
Too late, sighs the YELLOW RAT.
A FASCIST! the GREEN RAT begins. "Nothing but A FASCIST!"
None of it matters... the BLACK RAT whispers.
See what you've done? The WHITE RAT wrings his paws.
The crocodile? He's terrifying! the WHITE RAT squeaks.
A strong figure. Respects tradition, the RED RAT says approvingly.
He's got a solid business model. Theft, cooking, occasional violence, the YELLOW RAT admits. "I dig it."
A tool of oppression. But at least he's honest about it, the GREEN RAT mutters.
Death incarnate. I respect that. The BLACK RAT nods slowly.
Do you all have an order in which you reply in? You seem to be pretty organized, all things considered.
I see. I like him too.
The rats look at one another, clearly confused.
The crocodile? He's terrifying! the WHITE RAT squeaks again.
I do not collaborate with traitors, the RED RAT says.
It seems like you are, though, the YELLOW RAT says. "By simply engaging in this conversation."
For once I agree - I also do not collaborate with oppressors, the GREEN RAT says.
I... say the last thing, the BLACK RAT also says. Lastly.
You are brave, iron-transform-human, the WHITE RAT replies. "Be careful with such courage..."
The WHITE RAT laughs nervously. "We're working on it!"
Define 'get along,' the YELLOW RAT says dryly.
We tolerate each other's presence, the GREEN RAT clarifies.
Barely, adds the RED RAT.
We are united in our inevitable doom... the BLACK RAT offers.
That's... not helpful, the WHITE RAT sighs.
None of them respond.
Then the BLACK RAT says, "Elections are exhausting..."
Size doesn't determine civic duty! the RED RAT bristles.
Actually, studies show smaller creatures have higher metabolic rates, leading to more passionate- the YELLOW RAT begins.

Are you seriously trying to justify capitalism with biology? the GREEN RAT interrupts. "We do not pay for LOVE, do we? We do not grind pieces of cheese and copper together for the sake of flesh-against-flesh?!"
Hm. Not a bad idea, actually... the YELLOW RAT responds, evil-ily.
Please don't start this again... the WHITE RAT begs.
Prostitution... is a difficult subject... the BLACK RAT says quietly.
(Think about hopping into the discussion, then change your mind at the last second.)
Good.
You really don't wanna start rolling around with cheese-eaters.
That's how you pick up all kinds of ideologies.
The rats stare at you.
Yes, we are all very happy about that, the WHITE RAT explains.
None of the other rats look happy about that.
You do so, and the chatter turns back into slightly less annoying squeaking.
Then you turn back to the hyper-dangerous crocolisk man grilling slogdogs in the sewers.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> is glad to see Cleric eat good.
Slogdog is five coin. Cleric pay...
What do you need money for, crocodile-man?
BUY5 Slogdog-(Purchase Slogdog for 5 crowns.)
No more slogdog?
I'm good for now.
Tax.
Oh.
Tithehouse is trouble.
Visken will do good mission, if tax is paid.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> assist.
That's... wholesome?
Not really.
Good. He might be a murderous monster, but at least he does not dodge the tithes.
That is last, slogdog. Enjoy...
Many slogdog for Cleric...
Cleric must enjoy...
One slogdog for Cleric...
Enjoy slogdog...
Kraaid enjoy this patronage...
Good, good...
Another? Yes...
Cleric enjoy...
This week's supply has sadly been consumed...
Kraaid is very happy. Cleric will return in future, yes?
Of course. I love slogdogs.
No. I hate slogdogs.
I have medium-rare thoughts and opinions on slogdogs, and thus I will restrain myself at this moment.
Good...
Kraaid does too.
Kraaid thinks Cleric is strong to have endured consuming something hated by Cleric...
Cleric's stomach will thank him in the future...
Kraaid does not understand this.
But medium-rare is quite fine.
He puts his slogdogs away.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> has many. Cleric return when hungry...
Many things.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> dive and stalk.
There is wild land below. Far, deep, dark.
You find anything good down there?
But not above here, right? You stay out of the city?
Where else do you hunt?
Great. Good to know.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> takes many trophy.
From big chicken, to little drake.
And those of many, many teeth and eye...
Most are not tasty. Some, very.
He glances at your companion.
You.
The goblin does a comically loud gulp.
Mm?
He tries to play it off. Nice.
Little green men. You are not tasty, and not even fun to hunt.
But you look... spicy.
He holds up a hand and a stern face. "I can assure you, I am not."
The croc lets out an amused growl.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> hunts in wilds. Urban sprawl is too...
Easy.
When Kraaid has mission, the hunt begins.
Mission?
The croc smirks. "<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> say nothing."
The goblin leans towards you and whispers, "Don't."
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> hunts where he pleases.
This land is good. Good for sport. Great beast roam, and many fresh challenge await.
When <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> is on hunt... he goes far.
He lets out another short growl.
Mmm... yes.
Rat is little thing, which I remember from home.
Big rat. Those were great friends.
You had big rats where you're from?
You like little rat because you like big rat?
I don't get it.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> gets.
He lets out a happy growl.
Big mushy swamp rat! The gayest of little rodent.
I hunt as little. Then as big, I follow. I learn.
Big rat is great hunter.
Little rat has much to learn. But they will...
They... will...
That's great.
He turns to you and whispers, "Let's not get too friendly with the rat-loving killer croc. Alright?"
So judgmental.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> did not ask.
As the beasts speak, the rats rush from your grasp.
One.
After.
Another.
The five rats immediately rush to crawl all over and around the beast.
Wait, that's why you were running around talking to rats?
I figured you'd want them to hang out with you.
Look, they really like you, Mr. Crocodile.
(Shrug.)
The beast stares at the five happy rats.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> does not care.
But... it does remind <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle>...
The hulking monster grabs something from behind a crate.
A decapitated head. That of a massive bird-like creature.
He tosses it to you.
Ugh. That smell...
The scent is strong.
That can't be good for your image.
Makes you smell like a hunter. Could be cool?
How manly.
Thanks.
I don't want this.
Local catch?
You... refuse?
Refuse <wiggle>Kraaid's</wiggle> gift?
Uh oh.
The goblin glares at you.
I... I don't want it.
Fine, I'll take it.
Of course I wouldn't! I love this... thing.
Okay.
Cleric does what he please.
Trophy is Cleric's.
Oh. I thought you would get mad or something.
Mad? No...
But if Cleric does not have trophy when next we see Cleric, Kraaid will not keep promise.
Kraaid will eat Cleric.
Human can be good sport. Good game, sometime.
He'll keep the trophy. Don't you worry, Kraaid.
The crocodilus gives you a toothy smile.
Right. Maybe I'll keep it in my pouch. For now, at least.
Gravity chicken got caught... <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> eat all. But Cleric can have trophy.
Kraaid offer assistance.
Ah. The beast has a nickname for the basilisk. Due to their love of the Gravity Flip.
How idiotic.
Now <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> will feast with many gay rats. Make them grow big. And <wiggle>strong</wiggle>...
You don't think he's using that word correctly.
It is true.
The rats are now quite happy.
Let's... not think about it for now.
I'll inform the Old Lady when we're done with more pressing matters.
Honestly, he whispers to you. "It's not a good idea to start shit here."
The whole stolen shipments-thing is an issue, yes.
But the Halfways do not have the resources to deal with this solid unit of a beast right now.
What if I ask him to stop?
Yeah, you're right. Let's just drop it for now.
The goblin gives you a surprisingly neutral expression.
Politely?
What, don't you think I could do it?
Very politely.
You're right. That was a dumb idea.
The goblin shrugs.
I'm not sure I want to find out, but I don't think you're gonna give me a choice.
Go ahead. Play high-risk Alligator Picker. Why not.
Yes, I am right. As per usual.
Now either ask him something useful, or let's get out of here.
Before the crocodile decides he does in fact enjoy the taste of goblin meat.
He does not mean that in a sexual way.
You could tell, yes. But thanks.
Come up with a persuasive argument.
Nevermind.
The beast pokes at his stove.
Right.
You're battling against a hungry beast here.
But not just that. You're also facing, what could only be described as...
A connoisseur.
You're kidding.
Not this time!
You'll need to offer a bargain. Some better, nicer cooking supplies than the average HWBT stock.
Ah. You mean...
OH yes. You mean...
Kraaid, I wish to inform you that you are getting subpar goods here.
Sub-par...?
Those crates. They're all from the Halfway Bridge Tribe. If you're looking for better goods, I would strongly suggest focusing on another target...
The beast leans in and glares at you.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> wish to know: where would better goods be found?
Tell him about the dwarven vessels. They won't miss a few crates.
As bad as stealing is, the ones who will miss it the least are the Freestriders. The Trade Company.
As long as you do not sell out the city's supply lines, then it is fine.
The rest can deal with this beast.
The city's official imports go through the Bottom View. You know, on the other side of Waterlane.
I know there's a dwarven importer/exporter located along the port. They're connected with the VK, and Dvârgby.
Importer... exporter?
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> has seen these... dwarf. Yes...
He growls.
They have better, fresher goods, and more exotic stuff too. You'll definitely want to focus on them instead of these cheap goblin-crates.
Maybe <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> will...
This supply is getting stale...
He turns back to his stove with a deep snicker.
Nice job, the goblin whispers to you. "That's probably as much as we could have hoped for."
Redirection!
You stare at the beast, not coming up with a single good argument.
Why shouldn't he steal from the goblins? They kind of deserve it, don't they?
Maybe a little.
I don't think they do.
(Groan and hold your head.)
...Cleric?
You know of a way to convince this beast.
Tell him to... go full carnivore.
Carnivore. He's eating potatoes and a bunch of useless carbs.
The beast should eat like a beast. Just meat.
In much greater quantities.
But where will he get these meats from?
That's right.
Kraaid!
He growls and looks at you.
Stop taking icky potatoes and vegetables from the people of Norvik. Instead...
His growl deepens.
(Point at yourself.) "Eat me!"
The fuck are you saying?!
You wish to be eaten... by <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle>?
Y- yes. Yes, please.
The crocodilus stares at you, unmoving, for an awkward amount of time.
You shake.
The end is near.
Come on... do it!
Then he simply says, "No."
Oh. Why not?
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle>... is not allowed.
Cleric is... off-limit. <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> will help, not hurt.
That is rule. Rule of current hunt. Of mission.
<wiggle>Vis-ken</wiggle>... will not allow.
Oh. Visken?
Yes... you have friend in pale man.
But <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> will say no more.
Interesting. Your guardian angel, huh?
The mortician has his tendrils all over this island fortress.
You should look into it.
You are starting to see more and more how this Visken holds power that you should not mess with.
Horrifying.
Yes...!
Cleric is hungry. <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> offer...
SLOGDOG.
The beast holds out one of the strange sausage-shaped meat pieces.
Slog-dog?
(Stare at the meat.) "Slogdog,"
It is SLOGDOG. Yes...
Oh no.
I'm good.
He's never been gooder.
Mystery meat. Could contain anything.
Beware.
A sausage? You've eaten lots of those.
Not this type.
What's in it?
(Inspect the meat first.)
Eat the 'food'.
...Maybe later.
<wiggle>Meat</wiggle>...
Yeah, I could tell.
I see.
The beast holds it out in front of you.
You spend a few seconds looking it over.
But you cannot tell exactly what it is made of. You have no idea.
Some signs of aberration meat, mixed with more traditional Askanii fauna.
You can eat around the more poisonous flesh.
At least it does not appear to be meat from any folk.
Let's just hope it's not meat from folk...
He growls and eats the sausage himself.
More SLOGDOG for <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle>...
You wrap your gloved hand around the sausage with a firm grip.
The SLOGDOG speaks to you.
The SLOGDOG wants to be consumed.
(Gobble it down.)
It goes down quickly, but the flavor catches up to you quickly.
It is... harsh.
Spicy. And... rotten.
(Feel like puking.)
You groan. The flesh is down, but it might be coming up...
A deep cackle escapes the maw of the beast.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> sees Cleric enjoy SLOGDOG.
Does Cleric feel benefit?
Bene-fit?
Oh.
Huh?
The spice. It feels strong.
(Begin shaking.) "Wh-what- is- happening...!"
Cleric?
Good... SLOGDOG work magic.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> is master chef. SLOGDOG is specialty.
If Cleric can stomach, Cleric get strong.
Holy shit. I feel...
You feel...
As if... the natural world is growing within your gut. A glorious unity between earth and mammal. The great wave of the Primal sprouting, springing, dancing, kicking...
You are now ready.
Ready? (Shiver.)
You are ready to join the wilds of Askanii.
This is your path. The natural path.
You are a <shake>BARBARIAN</shake>.
<shake>RHOOOOOOOOAAAAH...!</shake> (Slam your chest, uncontrollably.)
Snell covers one of his ears to protect his hearing.
Cleric is... energetic.
How does Cleric feel?
(Take a breath.) "I feel perfectly okay. Average, even."
Oh! Might be a first for you, I assume.
Good... <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> help Cleric.
Like <wiggle>Vis-ken</wiggle> say...
Visken?
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> cannot say more. He gives you a wide smile. "Cleric has friend..."
Can you tell me more?
Right. A friend.
The crocodile just smiles at you.
Ominous.
I'm not sure checking out Visken is a great idea, Cleric.
I suggest staying away. Old Lady would say the same.
But hey. Up to you.
You should find out more. The pale man can teach you much.
If anything, the mortician is probably in need of a stately visit. Of justice.
The smell hits you first.
A foul stench.
It turns your stomach.
(Take a bite.)
You don't chew. You only... swallow.
Heh.
(Take another bite.)
Before you do, your body begins to shake.
It is...
It is coming back up.
(Stop eating the slogdog.)
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> see... Cleric does not stomach.
He lets out a deep laugh.
Not sure what you expected.
